risks.title: Rules gaps
risks.text: Price curve, minor-nation demand, several job durations and the score formula are not in the manual. M2/M3 use documented defaults until closed.

risks.title: Code disagrees with the rules
risks.text: Recipes, prices, costs, durations and the 1900 start year differ from the original game. Listed as CODE MISMATCH lines in docs/rules; M2 fixes them.

risks.title: M1 is the riskiest change
risks.text: It touches the store and every action. Gate: two-nation 20-turn test, replay test, e2e smoke, one Opus review.

decisions.title: Continue or restart?
decisions.ruling: Continue; v1 scope M0 to M4 approved (2026-11-02).

decisions.title: Delete superseded branches and untrack old tool configs?
decisions.ruling: Yes, including the push to origin.

decisions.title: v3 nation AI: scripted, LLM or both?
Who merges a milestone PR?
decisions.context: Low involvement versus your usual PR review. With agent merge you watch this page and can revert; with your merge each milestone waits for you.
decisions.suggestion: Agent merges after the gate and the milestone review are green; you review on this page and in the running app.

decisions.title: Run milestones without ultracode workflows?
decisions.context: Your profile says coding runs as ultracode (build, review, verify per task). In the work repo, review and verify agents were 32% of spend and follow-up rounds 10%.
decisions.suggestion: Yes for this project: one review per milestone instead of per task, postponed to the milestone end but never skipped.

decisions.title: Use NotebookLM over gameplay videos to close rules gaps?
decisions.context: Videos can show on-screen values: university, armoury and shipyard costs, starting state, power plant, score screen, relationship levels; partly price series and job durations. They cannot show hidden formulas (trade-partner weighting, credit, combat, council, AI).
decisions.suggestion: Yes, but only for that on-screen list, before M3. Hidden formulas get designed defaults instead, which suits v2 changes anyway.
